scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend build
